title: Chapter 146 Territory Reform
content:
Chapter 146 Territory Reform

"Suo Yong, you should learn from Duan Wenxi on this point. Do you think he is in charge of too few things now?"

Suo Yong thought for a while, much more than himself.

"Look, for the registration of new refugees, did he find someone to work part-time?"

"So, you must also learn to find some helpers."

Suo Yong suddenly realized it, his face showed a hint of joy, and he said in surprise: "My subordinate has realized it!"

"Go to work!"

"Yes, Lord." Suo Yong thought about Wang Shuo's words as he walked, and almost fell down on the way.

Wang Shuo shook his head.

At 5:30 pm, Wang Shuo finally heard the system prompt he wanted.

[The construction of the black iron city wall in Wana Village, your territory, has been completed. 】

Wang Shuo quickly ran to the city wall and inspected it carefully.

The city wall is ten meters high and about 5 meters wide. The middle of the city wall is filled with rammed earth.

Follow the horse path and walk up to the city wall.

Above the city gate is a two-story archery tower where archers can be stationed.

Every few dozen meters, there is a "horse face" protruding outward. On the wide platform, heavy weapons such as crossbows and bed crossbows can be placed, causing huge damage to the enemies attacking the city.

With the blessing of hundreds of accelerating talismans, it took only two days to build the city wall, which made Wang Shuo very satisfied.

Wang Shuo found a battlement and squatted under it, hiding like a naughty child.

At this time, Yan Fujie and others came over and were confused when they saw Wang Shuo's inexplicable behavior.

Wang Shuo stood up awkwardly, coughed slightly, and said loudly: "Thank you for your hard work, everyone. You have done a good job. After blocking the bandits, we will reward you based on your merits!"

When everyone heard that there was actually a reward, they all cheered.

Since they were forced to join the village, they have gone from being forced labor to having a sense of identity with the village and actively participating in construction. They have never expected any rewards. Wang Shuo suddenly said this and felt very happy in his heart.

Wang Shuo saw Xiao Laoteng wanted to speak and said first, "Everyone has worked hard today. Let's have a rest first and prepare to deal with the bandits tomorrow."

After saying that, he slipped away.

Only Xiao Laoteng was left messy in the wind.

At night, after Ayub and others returned, Wang Shuo summoned all the managers to hold a meeting.

All members of the Swift Scout Team, plus Duan Wenxi, Suo Yong, Xu Mingzhong, Matar and others, came to the meeting hall.

"Everyone, as the territory develops, I have some new ideas."

Wang Shuo glanced at everyone, and everyone listened carefully.

"We roughly confiscated supplies from the previously recruited residents. This method is not suitable for subsequent refugees."

"So, I decided to give some compensation to the previous subjects. Each person should be compensated 2,000 gold coins!"

"During this period, many people have made great contributions to the territory. I also decided to provide some materials as rewards, including skills, gold coins, and some equipment."

Wang Shuo looked at Duan Wenxi and then said: "Wenxi, you come and draw up a list, and we will finalize it together."

"In addition, I plan to divide the household registration in the territory into three types, one is military registration, one is civil registration, and one is craftsman registration."

"For military and craftsmen, we will pay them monthly wages and include food and accommodation."

“For nationality, there are no such benefits.”

"This is both a reward and an incentive."

"Anyone who has participated in the village defense battle will join the military or craftsmanship."

"Build a canteen. From tomorrow, you will have to pay for meals. Military and craftsmanships will be deducted from wages. Build a grocery store and allow citizens to buy supplies by themselves. At the same time, open a channel for the exchange of resources with the heart of the sanctuary. We need citizens They have the heart of shelter in their hands, but they have to exchange it with resources if they wish.”

"Also, our residential buildings are no longer free to use, but rent is required. Duan Wenxi is responsible for the specific matters."
